sharing.enableHint: Users of this NutriTrace server can share foods and meals with each other.
sharing.disableText: All foods and meals of all users become private again, and every share is removed.
sharing.off: Sharing is turned off on this server.
sharing.bulkHint: Changes the visibility of all your existing items.

email.description: The mail server each app sends with.

intro.nt: Tokens give scripts access to NutriTrace's /api/v1 and MCP.
intro.ct: Tokens give scripts and other apps access to CookTrace's API and MCP.
intro.lt: Tokens give MCP clients access to LiftTrace.

tokens.onlyOnce: Copy it now; it isn't shown again.
tokens.name: Token name
tokens.revokeText: Whatever uses this token loses access.

webhooks.disabled: Webhooks are turned off on this server (WEBHOOKS_ENABLED).
webhooks.newSecret: Signing secret of the new webhook

users.ssoHint: Accounts are created at the first sign-in through the shared identity provider; invite people there.
users.roleText: New role: {{role}}. A group in the identity provider may set it again at the next sign-in.
users.deleteText: The account and all its data in this app are deleted. This can't be undone.
users.trainerRequested: Request sent: {{name}} has to accept it

oidc.description: Providers each app accepts sign-ins from. The provider of Trace is set by the server's environment.
oidc.deleteText: Nobody can sign in through it any more.
oidc.passwordLoginHint: Trace signs in through single sign-on only; this is set on the server.
oidc.keepSecret: Leave empty to keep the stored secret.

fields.auto_link_verified_email: Link existing accounts by verified email

presetHelp.auth0: Auth0 puts custom claims under a namespaced name; leave the group claim empty until your tenant exposes roles.
presetHelp.authelia: The issuer is the address Authelia is served at, without a path.
presetHelp.authentik: The issuer is the “OpenID Configuration Issuer” on the provider's page.
presetHelp.google: Google sends no groups; make admins by hand after their first sign-in.
presetHelp.keycloak: Add a “groups” mapper to the client's default scope so the ID token carries groups.
presetHelp.pocket-id: Pocket ID signs in with passkeys. Add the redirect URI to its OIDC client.
presetHelp.custom: Any OpenID Connect provider with authorization code flow, PKCE and discovery.
